data.long_meaning: Emlyn is a Welsh name meaning 'little one' or 'ruler'. Its Welsh origin suggests a connection to the Celtic people and their rich spiritual traditions. This name has been popularized in modern times and is often given to both boys and girls. The name Emlyn carries the meaning “Little one, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Emlyn usually hope their child will grow to embody little one, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Ἠμλυν
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἠμλυν προέρχεται από τo ελληνικό όνομα και σημαίνει 'αντίπαλος' ή 'ζηλωτής'. Η λέξη συνδέεται με το ελληνικό 'αμίμησις' που σημαίνει 'μίμησις' ή 'προσομοίωσις'.
